Anthropic Targets November IPO as Revenue Surges
items.summaryEn: Anthropic plans to launch its initial public offering in November, later than the October debut many investors had expected, The Wall Street Journal reported Friday (Sept. 18), citing unnamed sources. Δ document.getElementById( "ak_js_1" ).setAttribute( "value", ( new Date() ).getTime() ); The November date may have been chosen to allow Anthropic to share its third-quarter financials, which are expected to show strong results. The date was chosen before the recent debate about whether artificial intelligence is developing too quickly, according to the report.
